method: Continuation of commoncrawl-missing-assets-raw-index-2026-07-27.json. Downloaded every remaining cluster.idx advertised by the preserved Common Crawl collections inventory, selected both bounding CDX gzip blocks for each SURT prefix by binary search, range-fetched and decompressed each independent CDX member, and matched CDXJ rows by exact SURT-key prefix.
acceptanceRule: A CDX hit is only a locator. Recovery still requires range-fetching its ARC/WARC record and validating the embedded response, payload signature, MIME, dimensions or ZIP integrity, and SHA-256.
